requests.subject: composed.ProgramRebuild
requests.host_note: Runs in a disposable real OS directory on every supported host; root and realpath spellings are normalized. No watcher scheduling is exercised.
requests.discriminates: Cached metadata must be cleared after each build; a fresh cached/tracking compiler host discovers physical create/delete/edit mutations, reads changed source and syntax errors, reuses an unchanged file, retains the first bound file and records missing roots and explicitly seeded wildcard directories.
